Brooke Eden's "No Shade" — original release 2015. Brooke Eden Helvie (born December 30, 1988), known professionally as Brooke Eden, is an American country music singer and songwriter.

Artist: Brooke Eden · Title: No Shade · Album: No Shade · Year: 2021 · Genre: Country · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/2020's/Brooke Eden - No Shade.mp4.

Eden auditioned for both the seventh and tenth seasons of American Idol, making it to Hollywood week on the former.

She signed with Red Bow Records in 2015 after generating interest for her self-released single "American Dreamin'".
